notices.dropNeedsAttach: Add this file to the project first (drop it on the canvas or press Add), then place it on the main track.

refusals.unresolved: This scene has no length yet.
refusals.narration_bound: This scene follows its narration: it is split by its script, and its length by the voice.
refusals.pending: Something is still being prepared here; try again when it is ready.
refusals.split_at_edge: Move the playhead inside a clip to split it.
refusals.crosses_layer: A text, shape or Motion crosses the playhead; trim or move it first.
refusals.crosses_audio: Scene audio crosses the playhead; split it somewhere else.
refusals.animated_after_cut: An animated layer lies after the playhead; remove its animations first.
refusals.anchor_crosses: An animation is linked across the playhead; unlink it first.
refusals.leaves_gap: No media reaches the playhead, so the first part would get shorter.
refusals.outside_source: The video has no more footage there.
refusals.clip_animated: This clip has animations; remove them before splitting it.
refusals.no_room: There is no room for that here.
refusals.out_of_bounds: That goes past what the clip allows.
refusals.not_attached: Add this file to the project first.
refusals.audio_on_main: Audio goes on the music lane, not the main track.
refusals.not_audio: Only an audio file can be a music bed.
refusals.narration_delete: Narration is changed in the scene's voice settings.
